description: Active blog or news of the store (ZnodeBlogNews) published, inside its activation/expiration dates, with an SEO title (and description when asked), so the CMS search finds it; its title matches no other searchable blog/news. Outputs: seoTitle, seoDescription, contentText. Read only.

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)

blogNewsType.description: ZnodeBlogNews.BlogNewsType the test searches: Blog or News

contentPageActive.description: false: the record's associated CMS content page (CMSContentPagesId) must be inactive. Left out: any

withSeoDescription.description: Pass true when the test asserts the SEO description (it must be set). Left out: any

withContentText.description: Pass true when the test searches with contentText: it must be non-blank visible text (tags, line breaks, tabs,   and spaces removed). Left out: any
